articles.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
articles.description: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

articles.title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
articles.description: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

articles.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
articles.description: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.

articles.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
articles.description: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin clings to $80,000 as Strategy’s cushion thins before earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin slipped nearly 2% ahead of Strategy’s third-quarter results, and the largest corporate holder’s coins are now worth only about 6% more than it paid for them.

articles.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
articles.description: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.

articles.title: Bermuda taps WalletConnect to advance its onchain economy plan
articles.description: Bermuda chose WalletConnect to bring crypto payments to local merchants, starting with ticketing platform PTIX in the second quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
articles.description: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.

articles.title: The chart bitcoin traders should be paying attention to
articles.description: A market at an inflection point could shape inflation trends and the prices of risk assets, from bitcoin to tech stocks.

articles.title: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public
articles.description: Three flaws a language-model scan dug up are the first disclosed under Core’s new rules for bugs that are easy to find.

articles.title: Security failure at Indian certificate firm bites Ethereum as developers rush out fixes
articles.description: A key blunder at Indian certificate issuer eMudhra left some Teku and Besu setups trusting forged certificates. Default mainnet nodes weren’t exposed.

articles.title: Utah charges predictions platform Kalshi with illegal gambling
articles.description: Utah has filed criminal charges against betting platform Kalshi and its co-founders.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly dips below $80,000 as tech jitters and hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Alphabet and Samsung-drove tech weakness and a hawkish Fed hold triggered a broad risk-off move. Crypto futures saw $356 million in liquidations.

articles.title: Mystery Wall Street Journal ad sparks new fight over tokenized stocks
articles.description: A full-page warning urging CEOs to opt out of tokenized stock trading drew a response from Securitize and questions over who paid for it.

articles.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
articles.description: Prospective borrowers face collateral liquidation risks if bitcoin prices drop, though APX said property and crypto collateral will be handled distinctly.

articles.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
articles.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission held a forum in which the chairman, Mike Selig, suggested AI agents may usher in a financial revolution.

articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.description: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
articles.description: A rate hike in December remains likely as the U.S. central bank continues to focus on inflation, which remains well above its 2% target.

articles.title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
articles.description: Coinbase faces a key earnings test as analysts debate the strength of its trading rebound following a sharp drop in Robinhood's crypto revenue.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What happens when an AI agent pays for the wrong thing
articles.description: The largest card networks now sit in the top governance tier of x402, the standard that AI agents use to pay for things online. Albert Castellana of GenLayer Labs explains why that standard has no way to dispute a charge, and what happens when the payment settles but the agent receives something wrong or useless.

articles.title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
articles.description: DTCC's tokenization service went live on Canton Network and private chain Besu, with JPMorgan, Citi and Morgan Stanley among 20 firms signed up.

articles.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Dell also say 'no' to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading plan
articles.description: Nearly half the companies on the venture’s original roster have now objected to their shares trading on the planned blockchain-based venue.

articles.title: Dissent and more: 3 things to watch for at the Fed meeting
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 28, 2026

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
articles.description: An experimental change would let companies cover the reserve for customer and AI-agent accounts, allowing users to start with stablecoins without first acquiring XRP.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $81,000 as Asian chip rally spills into crypto, pepe jumps 9%
articles.description: Bitcoin rose above $81,400 as Asian chip stocks rallied, with frog-themed memecoin pepe adding 9%.
